test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows. 

The pie-chart shows the monthly expenditure incurred by a family on various items and their savings. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/583b4f3db9000dd5e024bb4f9eb3106019a1c0d3aa9c850a7978580ebfba6035.png] 

If the total expenditure on education is Rs. 23,520, then what is the expenditure on clothing (in Rs.)?
solution:
**Given:**

Total expenditure on education = ₹23,520

Percentage spent on education = 28%

Percentage spent on clothing = 12%

**Formula used:**

Total Expenditure = (Expenditure on education / Percentage spent on education) × 100

Expenditure on clothing = (Percentage spent on clothing / 100) × Total Expenditure

**Calculation:**

Total Expenditure = (23,520 / 28) × 100 = 84,000

Expenditure on clothing = (12 / 100) × 84,000

⇒ Expenditure on clothing = 10,080

**∴ The expenditure on clothing is ₹10,080.**
